5013 Primavera Lane
Killeen, TX 76549
$301,900, 3 bed, 2.00 bath, 1,757 SF, MLS# 608674

Live at the epicenter of convenience. This 3BD/2BA gem boasts a seamless open-concept layout, the living room, dining room, and kitchen connect to become the heart of the home. The perfect place to gather with family and create long-lasting memories. Immediately off the foyer, elegant French doors open into a bright, versatile flex space, perfect for a quiet home office, home gym, private study, a sophisticated reading room, or guest parlor.
Nestled in a vibrant hub near Fort Hood, Texas A & M University, Central Texas Community College, Scott & White Clinic, Advent Health Hospital, and steps away from coffee shops, restaurants, and daily essentials. Situated in a vibrant, walkable neighborhood, this home offers the perfect blend of suburban comfort and city accessibility. Experience the joy of community living in this welcoming neighborhood. Imagine weekend mornings starting with a short stroll to the local ice cream shop, followed by a picnic in your own private back yard. This is the serene lifestyle your family deserves. It’s more than a house; it’s a lifestyle! Don't let this home slip away, schedule your showing today!

2 full bath
